lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce2Zn6Pt2 (CeZn3Pt) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers coordinated by 14 neighbors (8 Pt, 6 Zn), while Pt adopts an octahedral environment with six Zn neighbors and Zn exhibits several environments with 9, 10, and 12 geometric neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Pt octahedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Ce and Pt polyhedra, and face-sharing between Ce and Zn polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites.
